training_source: self-play and multi-policy games against six uploaded opponents
runtime_use: Only Crustle/Kangaskhan matchup; compare up to 5 complete own-turn counterfactual plans through up to 12 decisions; override base FSM only at >=0.10 learned-value margin.
hidden_information: Uses only public observations plus deterministic completion from the known opponent deck list; no access to actual hidden cards.
